video_title: Jeremy Lin Opens Up on Knicks 2026 Finals Run & the Shadow of Linsanity

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin would have accepted less money to stay with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I would have played for significantly less if that meant staying with the Knicks
quotes.quote: I would have played for significantly less if that meant staying with the Knicks, significantly less because my heart was always here.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin was unaware his Madison Square Garden introduction received a standing ovation
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know, but apparently it was close to a standing ovation or a standing ovation
quotes.quote: I didn't know, but apparently it was close to a standing ovation or a standing ovation. I'm instructed to look into the camera, wave, and just stare into the camera and smile. So I'm not looking, I can't see the greater arena. It wasn't until after when Scott Van Pelt told me he was like, they gave you a standing ovation and I was like, really? I did not know that, but obviously just completely completely blown away.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin hoped to stay with the Knicks longer to help the team
quotes.excerpt: I was expecting and hoping and praying to be back for more seasons
quotes.quote: I was expecting and hoping and praying to be back for more seasons to give more performances to be able to help take us further. And so to me there's always a little bit of like, Knicks fans deserve more and I wasn't able to do that for them.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin explains his past anxiety during media interviews
quotes.excerpt: If you put me in an interview, I would tense up, I would be starting to sweat
quotes.quote: If you put me in an interview, I would tense up, I would be starting to sweat and have, you know, I have that. When I used to walk into a restaurant and people started to recognize me like, oh that's Jeremy Lin, I would immediately tense up and have goosebumps or like duck my head. It makes me nervous.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin's parents sacrificed their savings to support his NBA dream
quotes.excerpt: My mom emptied out her entire 401k so that I could eat until I was full
quotes.quote: My mom emptied out her entire 401k so that I could eat until I was full so that I could prepare for the NBA draft. And at that time we were very far in debt. We had already borrowed from the bank, we had borrowed from the house, we had borrowed from Harvard. No one would let us borrow anymore and then we had to borrow from family.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin's parents were laid off shortly after he joined the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Within four weeks, both my parents were laid off
quotes.quote: I finally signed with the Warriors on a partial guarantee, rookie minimum. And I kid you not, within four weeks, both my parents were laid off. And they could never find a job after that and they were consistently looking and nobody would hire.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin discusses the rumors about his relationship with Kim Kardashian
quotes.excerpt: I know that request did come in to the Knicks, and that is a real request
quotes.quote: That request did come in to the Knicks, and that is a real request. I think basically she at that time was filming her show, which is, I don't know if it's Keeping Up with the Kardashians or whatever show was happening back then, but I know that she was looking for kind of like a New York athlete.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin reflects on the impact of Linsanity
quotes.excerpt: Linsanity really grew me up and I became different
quotes.quote: I do feel like Linsanity really grew me up and I became different and why I'm now able to kind of speak out and carry the mantle, not as a weight, but to carry it as a source of pride, to embrace being Asian-American, to be able to speak up and to do these things and to be able to say, yes, I was that player that started Linsanity.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin and Carmelo Anthony had a private discussion about their past
quotes.excerpt: I was able to have a good conversation with Carmelo Anthony because of the current Knicks stretch

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: I was able to have a good conversation with Carmelo Anthony because of the current Knicks stretch and so we talked a lot about things that happened and we were able to have a very good clear the air discussion privately.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: And so I think now it's it's appropriate to, you know, share these things and

text_blocks.speaker: Jeremy Lin
text_blocks.text: I was crushed when the Knicks, it wasn't just when the Knicks didn't match. And I still remember that very vividly because in my mind I'm like, everything leading up to it is a three-day period, but everything even before the three-day period I was like, there's no way they match, there's no way they match. And that three-day period felt like three months.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Lin explains why he cannot be topped by other players
quotes.excerpt: You cannot top Linsanity. I was the number one most searched person on Google
quotes.quote: You cannot top Linsanity. I was the number one most searched person on Google. I was the most popular person on the planet. How do you top that? You cannot top that.
